scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Huh huh, a Rune-Midgartsian.
I guess this is your first
visit to my village, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
呵呵，一位来自卢恩·米德加兹的人。
我想，这应该是你第一次
来到我的村庄，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Everyone from Rune-Midgarts
that I've met had the same
same expression on their
face as you do right now
when they first came here.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我见过的每一个来自卢恩·米德加兹的人，
第一次来到这里时，
脸上的表情都和你现在一样。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Maybe it's because they cannot
communicate with us due to
the language barrier, so
they have no idea what's going
on. Yeah, I understand...
Anyway, welcome to my village.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
也许是因为语言不通，
无法与我们交流，
所以完全不知道发生了什么。
嗯，我理解...
总之，欢迎来到我的村庄。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
My name is Karkatan, and I
am the chief of the Utan tribe.
You must be wondering how
I can speak your language.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我叫卡尔卡坦，
是乌坦部落的首领。
你大概在想，
我为什么能说你们的语言吧。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
It was taught to me long ago
by an adventurer from your
land. It's been a long time,
and I do not know what has
become of him...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
这是很久以前，
一位来自你们土地的冒险者教我的。
时间过去很久了，
我也不知道他后来怎么样了...

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Anyhow, I learned many things
about Rune-Midgartsian culture
and language.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
总之，我学到了很多
关于卢恩·米德加兹的文化和语言。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Sometimes, I teach the Utan
language, but I do not give
everyone that privilege.
If unscrupulous outsiders
learn the Utan language, they
may bring harm to my tribe.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
有时候，我会教人乌坦语，
但我不会把这个特权给所有人。
如果居心不良的外人学会了乌坦语，
可能会给我的部落带来伤害。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Before you can learn the Utan
language, first try to learn
Utan culture by exploring our
village.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
在你学习乌坦语之前，
先试着通过探索我们的村庄
来了解乌坦文化。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Although you are not able to
communicate with my people
right now, try to understand
our way of life through your
observations.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
虽然你现在还无法
与我的族人交流，
但试着通过观察
来理解我们的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Pay attention to the dress,
appearance and life style of the
local people. When you think
you understand enough about Utan
culture, come back to me and show me what you have learned.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
注意当地人的穿着、
外貌和生活方式。当你觉得自己
对乌坦文化有足够的了解时，
回来告诉我，向我展示你学到了什么。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Oh, it's you again. So...
Have you learned about Utan
culture? I want to hear your
opinion, as well as your impression.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
哦，又是你。那么...
你了解乌坦文化了吗？
我想听听你的看法，
以及你的印象。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
There are still some villagers
who are very naive about Rune-Midgartsians.
Usually, they fear encounters
with your people and will
hide themselves.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
还有一些村民
对卢恩·米德加兹人非常天真。
通常，他们害怕遇到你们的人，
会把自己藏起来。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
So...
May I help you with anything?
I assume you did not have much of
a problem looking around the
village, but it seems you have something to ask of me.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
那么...
有什么我可以帮你的吗？
我想你在村里四处看看
应该没有遇到什么大问题，
但看起来你似乎有事情要问我。

scripts.text: I want to learn Utan language.
scripts.translation: 我想学习乌坦语

scripts.text: Umbabah Umbabah?
scripts.translation: 乌巴巴 乌巴巴？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Hmmm...That's an awesome mask
you're wearing. We Utans like
wearing masks to keep from
showing our facial expressions.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
嗯...你戴的面具
真不错。我们乌坦人喜欢戴面具，
以免暴露自己的面部表情。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
That's why we wear masks all the
time. We believe that interaction
and treatment of other people
should not depend on how we look.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
所以我们总是戴着面具。
我们相信，与他人的互动和对待
不应该取决于我们的外表。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Alright. I am sure you are
qualified to learn the Utan
language. I will teach you how
speak and to read in Utan from
now on.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
很好。我相信你
有资格学习乌坦语。
从现在开始，我会教你
如何用乌坦语说话和阅读。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
However, I need you to get some
items ready so that we may proceed
with the lessons. First, we need
two different kinds of paper.
^3377FF10 Oil Paper^000000 and 
^3377FF5 Slick Paper^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
不过，我需要你准备一些
物品，以便我们开始课程。
首先，我们需要两种不同的纸。
^3377FF10油纸^000000和
^3377FF5光滑的纸^000000。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
We'll also need something to
write with. Let's use
^3377FF1 Squid Ink^000000 and
^3377FF1 Feather of Birds^000000.
Please bring me those, and I will
teach you when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我们还需要用来书写的东西。
让我们使用
^3377FF1墨汁^000000和
^3377FF1鸟羽^000000。
请把这些带给我，
当你准备好了，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
You don't seem to understand
our culture yet. You cannot
learn another language if you
do not understand the culture.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
看来你还不了解我们的文化。
如果不理解文化，
是无法学会另一种语言的。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
When you have that expression on
your face, Utans will be
intimidated... Since we do
not show our faces to others,
we are actually very
vulnerable to facial expression.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
当你露出那种表情时，
乌坦人会被吓到的……
因为我们从不向他人展示面部，
所以其实非常害怕别人的面部表情。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Go explore the village a little
longer. You can come back
anytime when you think you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
去村里多逛逛吧。
等你觉得自己准备好了，
随时都可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
In any case, what do you think
about my mask? It's the current
trend among us Utans...don't you
think it's awesome?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
话说回来，你觉得我的面具怎么样？
这是现在乌坦人很流行的款式……
你不觉得它很酷吗？

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Haha~ When you're just imitating
the sound, you won't make any
sense. Language is a mutual system
for the communication of thoughts and feelings.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
哈哈~ 如果只是单纯模仿声音，
是没有任何意义的。
语言是用于交流思想和感情的共同体系。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I regret to say that it seems that
nowadays, all peoples are no
longer sensitive to other cultures
in that respect.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
很遗憾，似乎如今的人们
对异文化都不再那么敏感了。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I see people that despise or
ridicule others that do not
understand them. It's really
sad that such bigotry still exists...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我见过一些人鄙视或嘲笑
那些无法理解他们的人。
这种偏见依然存在，真的很令人难过……

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
If you are interested in Utan
language, try to understand our
culture better and come back
when you're ready. I will
teach you the meanings of those sounds you are using.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
如果你对乌坦语感兴趣，
试着更深入地了解我们的文化，
等你准备好了再回来。
我会教你那些声音的含义。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Sometimes it's good to wander
without purpose. But it's
better to set a goal for
a journey if you want to
learn something out of
the experience.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
有时候漫无目的地闲逛也不错。
但如果你想从经历中学到东西，
最好给旅程设定一个目标。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Okay, I guess we're good to go.
Let's get the lesson started.
I hope you will communicate better
with Utans when we are done.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
好了，看来可以开始了。
让我们开始上课吧。
希望学完后，你能更好地与乌坦人交流。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Alright, that's all. Just forget
about how you've felt about Utans
before you learned the language.
Now go try to talk to Utans.
Conversation is a very important method in understanding others.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
好了，就到这里。
忘掉你在学习语言之前对乌坦人的看法吧。
现在去试着和乌坦人交谈。
对话是理解他人的重要方式。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Okay, if you have any business
in our village later, feel free
to talk to me. I will try to help
you as much as I can.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
好的，如果你以后在村里有什么事，
尽管来找我。
我会尽力帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I guess you are not ready yet...
Did you forget what items you
need? I will let you know
again, so please bring them
so that we can start the lesson.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
看来你还没准备好……
你忘了需要带什么物品了吗？
我再告诉你一次，请把它们带过来，
这样我们才能开始上课。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
^3377FF10 Oil Paper^000000,
^3377FF5 Slick Paper^000000,
^3377FF1 Squid Ink^000000,
^3377FF1 Feather of Birds^000000.
When you bring all of these,
I will teach you our language.

[Karkatan]
Puchuchartan must have sent you to
me. I need to check whether or not
you are qualified to request
her help...We Utans do not want
to help evil people.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
普楚查尔坦一定是派你来找我的。
我需要确认一下，
你是否有资格请求她的帮助……
我们乌坦人不想帮助邪恶的人。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Hmmmm....
It would be good to have a mask
that was made in Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
嗯……
如果能有一顶在卢恩·米德加兹制作的面具就好了……

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I wish to have ^3377FF1 Mr. Smile^000000.
To Utans, receiving a mask as a
present is considered an
honor. Maybe Puchuchartan
wants you to show us your respect by doing so.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我想要^3377FF1笑脸面具^000000。
对乌坦人来说，收到面具作为礼物
是一种荣幸。也许普楚查尔坦
是想让你通过这样做来表达对我们的尊重。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Oh, you brought it! Yes, I've
always wished that I could have
this mask! This is truly an
honor! Thank you, adventurer
from Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
哦，你带来了！是的，我一直希望能拥有这个面具！
这真是莫大的荣幸！
谢谢你，来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
I will tell Puchuchartan that I
confirmed your qualification.
Go and speak to her. Though I
am not sure what help she can give
you, I hope we will be able to return this favor.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我会告诉普楚查尔坦，我已经确认了你的资格。
去和她对话吧。
虽然我不确定她能给你什么帮助，
但我希望将来我们也能有机会回报这份恩情。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Did I tell you that you need
^3377FF1 Mr. Smile^000000?
Please bring that as proof
of your goodwill, as well
as your sense of honor.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
我告诉过你需要^3377FF1笑脸面具^000000吗？
请把它带来，作为你善意和荣誉感的证明。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
How's it going?
I wish I could guide you around
the village, but I cannot neglect
my duty as tribal chief.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
最近怎么样？
我真希望能带你逛逛村庄，
但我不能忽视作为部落首领的职责。

scripts.text:
[Karkatan]
Leading a tribe is not as easy
as it looks. You would understand
if you were in the same position
as me. Anyway, I hope you will enjoy your time in our village.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔卡坦]
领导一个部落并不像看起来那么容易。
如果你处在我的位置，你就会明白了。
总之，希望你在我们村庄度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你现在携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务
将部分物品存入仓库，
然后再回来。^000000

scripts.text:
[??????????]
Umbah umbah umbabah Utan umbah
Umbah mookala umbabah..
Umbabahumbah umbabah
Umbabah umbaba umbaumbah umbah
Hum umbah umbah.
scripts.translation:
[??????????]
Umbah umbah umbabah Utan umbah
Umbah mookala umbabah..
Umbabahumbah umbabah
Umbabah umbaba umbaumbah umbah
Hum umbah umbah.

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I did not expect that even
more of you Rune-Midgartsians
would find my village. I am
afraid that Mother Earth may
be caused suffering because
of this...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
没想到会有更多来自卢恩·米德加兹的人找到我的村庄。
我担心大地母亲会因此受到伤害……

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
You Rune-Midgartsians are a very
evil tribe...always accomplishing
your goals whether the means are
foul or fair, never hesitating to
ruin the property of others to get
what you want.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
你们卢恩·米德加兹人是一个非常邪恶的部落……
无论手段是否正当，都要达成目标，
为了得到想要的东西，从不犹豫破坏他人的财产。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I am worried how continuing
contact with the outside world
will affect our future...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我很担心与外界持续接触会如何影响我们的未来……

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
No one from Rune-Midgarts has 
visited me without some purpose
and I do not think that you
are an exception.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
从卢恩·米德加兹来找我的人，没有一个是没有目的的，
我想你也不例外。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I only use my power for the
service of my tribe, and do not
give my aid to strangers. If you
really need my help, go ask for
the chief's permission.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我只将我的力量用于服务我的部落，
不会帮助陌生人。
如果你真的需要我的帮助，
去请求首领的许可吧。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Also, I do not approve of
outsiders talking to the tribe
more than they have to...
We want to live a peaceful life, so do not disturb us.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
而且，我不赞成外来者与部落进行不必要的交谈……
我们想过平静的生活，所以请不要打扰我们。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I already told you to get the
chief's approval. There is also
the matter of my own business to take care of.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我已经告诉过你要获得首领的批准。
而且，我也有自己的事情要处理。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I know that you have gone through
many difficulties to come here,
but you have to leave now.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我知道你经历了许多困难才来到这里，
但你必须现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I've heard from the chief that he
has given you his approval...
Although I do not like this, I
will keep my promise. But it's
your call if you really need my help or not.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我听说首领已经给了你许可……
虽然我不喜欢这样，
但我会信守承诺。
至于你是否真的需要我的帮助，由你自己决定。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
My power allows me to create rough
enchanted stones and to divide a
pure enchanted stone into rough
ones. So I may be able to help
you in this way.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我的力量可以制作粗糙的附魔石，
也可以将纯净的附魔石分解为粗糙的附魔石。
所以我可能可以在这方面帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So come and speak to me when
you think my power may be
of service to you.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
所以，当你认为我的力量可能对你有用时，
就来和我对话吧。

scripts.text:
[Putsuchiritan]
I don't know whether my talents
will be useful to you, but I'll
help you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[普楚奇里坦]
我不知道我的才能是否对你有用，
但我会尽力帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Putsuchiritan]
I can create elemental essence from natural objects,
or, dismantle elemental stones into their component essences.
Which would you like to do?
scripts.translation:
[普楚奇里坦]
我可以从自然物体中创造元素精华，
或者将元素石分解为其成分精华。
你想做哪一个？

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Rune-Midgartsian who has asked for
my help...Although I am not sure
if you really need my power, I
will try to provide my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
向我请求帮助的卢恩·米德加兹人……
虽然我不确定你是否真的需要我的力量，
但我会尽力提供协助。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Wait--!
something in your possession
is disturbing my peace of
mind. This will not do...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
等等——！
你身上携带的某些东西
正在扰乱我的心神。
这可不行...

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Go leave your belongings
elsewhere, and only bring the
items that you need right now.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
请把你的物品放在别处，
只带你现在需要的东西过来。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
If you refuse to do so,
I cannot do anything for you.
Get yourself ready and then
come back.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
如果你拒绝这样做，
我就无法为你做任何事。
准备好后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Now, what do you wish to do?
My power allows me to create rough
enchanted stones and to divide a
pure enchanted stone into rough ones.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
那么，你想做什么？
我的力量可以制作粗糙的附魔石，
也可以将纯净的附魔石分解为粗糙的附魔石。

scripts.text: Create rough enchanted stones
scripts.translation: 制作粗糙的附魔石

scripts.text: Divide a pure enchanted stone
scripts.translation: 分解纯净的附魔石

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Do you wish to create rough
enchanted stones? Which
property do you wish to create?
Earth, Water, Fire, Wind...
...choose one.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
你想制作粗糙的附魔石吗？
你想制作哪种属性？
土、水、火、风...
...请选择一个。

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 风

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I will try to amplify the hidden
power of natural objects in
order to create rough enchanted
stones. Choose one number from
'1' to '9.' If you wish to cancel
this request, enter '0.'
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我将尝试放大自然物体中隐藏的力量，
以制作粗糙的附魔石。
请从'1'到'9'中选择一个数字。
如果你想取消此请求，请输入'0'。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I see. It's your call.
Come back when you need me.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我明白了。由你决定。
需要我的时候再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Remember to choose a number
from 1 to 9.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
记得从1到9中选择一个数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
boiling pot, and casting a
sacred incantation. Remember
the number you entered.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
...沸锅，并吟诵神圣的咒语。
记住你输入的数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I am putting these tails into a
boiling pot, and casting a
sacred incantation. Remember
the number you entered.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我将把这些尾巴放入沸锅中，
并吟诵神圣的咒语。
记住你输入的数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I am putting these shells into a
boiling pot, and casting a
sacred incantation. Remember
the number you entered.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我将把这些贝壳放入沸锅中，
并吟诵神圣的咒语。
记住你输入的数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I am putting these horns into a
boiling pot, and casting a
sacred incantation. Remember
the number you entered.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我将把这些角放入沸锅中，
并吟诵神圣的咒语。
记住你输入的数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Amba Omba Zatumba! Umba! Ti!
Umputaun Eulukaba! Umba! Ha!
Julu Humba Rulala! Umba! La!
Datuha Ombabalaka! Umba! Si!
Sunutaba Abulumba! Umba! Si!
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
安巴 翁巴 扎图姆巴！翁巴！提！
翁普陶恩 乌鲁卡巴！翁巴！哈！
朱鲁 翁巴 鲁拉拉！翁巴！拉！
达图哈 翁巴巴卡！翁巴！西！
苏努塔巴 阿布鲁姆巴！翁巴！西！

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I guess my power was not enough.
The natural power I gathered with
my spell lost focus and was scattered...
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
看来我的力量还不够。
我用咒语聚集的自然之力
失去了焦点并散逸了...

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
It seems the spirits of nature
were not in harmony at the moment.
However, if you come back later,
I will try to help you. Of course,
there will still be the same possibility that I may fail.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
似乎此刻自然的精灵们
并未处于和谐状态。
不过，如果你稍后回来，
我会再尽力帮助你。当然，
仍然有可能失败。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Here's the enchanted stone you
wished to have. I created this
with a lot of effort, so make
good use of it.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
这是你希望的附魔石。
我费了好大劲才制作出来，
请好好利用它。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Fire property...
I will need natural
objects that are filled with
the spirit of fire.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
火属性...
我需要充满火之精灵力量的
自然物体。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Water property...
I will need natural
objects that are filled with
the spirit of water.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
水属性...
我需要充满水之精灵力量的
自然物体。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Wind property...
I will need natural
objects that are filled with
the spirit of wind.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
风属性...
我需要充满风之精灵力量的
自然物体。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Earth property...I need natural
objects that are filled with
the spirit of the Earth.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
土属性...
我需要充满大地精灵力量的
自然物体。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
[普楚查尔坦]
这就是我需要的全部了...
准备好了再回来吧。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Scorpion which endures the
blazing heat of the desert
is brimming with fire energy.
I need ^3377FF20 Scorpion Tails^000000.
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
在沙漠酷热中生存的蝎子
充满了火之能量。
我需要^3377FF20蝎子尾巴^000000。
[普楚查尔坦]
这就是我需要的全部了...
准备好了再回来吧。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Ambernite...the spirit of
water is contained within its
protective shell...
I will need ^3377FF20 Snail's Shell.^000000
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
蜗牛...水之精灵
蕴含在它的保护壳中...
我需要^3377FF20蜗牛壳^000000。
[普楚查尔坦]
这就是我需要的全部了...
准备好了再回来吧。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Stainer...the beetle
that flies through the sky
has the wind's spirit.
I need ^3377FF25 Rainbow Shells^000000.
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
瓢虫...在天空中飞行的甲虫
拥有风之精灵。
我需要^3377FF25彩色昆虫外壳^000000。
[普楚查尔坦]
这就是我需要的全部了...
准备好了再回来吧。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Horn...that dwells in the forest
is filled with the spirits of
earth and wood...Horn...
I need ^3377FF15 Horn^000000 from Horns.
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
锹形虫...栖息在森林中
充满了大地与树木的精灵...锹形虫...
我需要来自锹形虫的^3377FF15锹形虫^000000。
[普楚查尔坦]
这就是我需要的全部了...
准备好了再回来吧。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Do you wish to divide a pure
enchanted stone into rough ones?
Which property do you want to
divide? Earth, Water, Fire, Wind... 
Choose one.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
你想把纯净的附魔石
分解成粗糙的吗？
你想分解哪种属性？土、水、火、风...
请选择一种。

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 风

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Please enter the
number of enchanted
stones that you wish
to divide. I can only
divide up to 10 at a time.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
请输入你想分解的
附魔石数量。我一次
最多只能分解10个。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
You're carrying too
many items right now.
Put some of your stuff
in Kafra Storage, and then
come back to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
你现在携带的物品太多了。
把一些东西存到卡普拉仓库，
然后再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I'll try to revert these
enchanted stones to their
rough forms. Enter a number
from 1 to 9, or enter 0 if
you decide to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我会尝试将这些附魔石
还原成粗糙的形式。请输入
1到9之间的数字，或者输入0
如果你决定取消的话。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
You want to cancel?
Well, if you change your
mind, feel free to come
ask me to help at any time.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
你想取消吗？
好吧，如果你改变主意，
随时欢迎回来找我帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Hm? You need to enter
a number from 1 to 9.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
嗯？你需要输入
1到9之间的数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I will now chant the
sacred words. Remember
the number you entered!
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我现在要吟唱
神圣的咒语了。记住
你输入的数字！

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Umba Umba Kalapum! Umba! Ta!
Lukura Ukulele Um! Umba! Ka!
Abulaka Tabulakan! Umba! La!
Ombaludu Zan Kunu! Umba! Ku!
Kum Tum Lakulakun! Umba! Ha!
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
Umba Umba Kalapum! Umba! Ta!
Lukura Ukulele Um! Umba! Ka!
Abulaka Tabulakan! Umba! La!
Ombaludu Zan Kunu! Umba! Ku!
Kum Tum Lakulakun! Umba! Ha!

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Here's the rough enchanted stones
you wished to have. I created this
with a lot of effort, so make good
use of them.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
这是你想要的粗糙附魔石。
我费了好大劲才制作出来，
请好好利用它们。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So, you wish to have rough
^3377FF{0} {1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
所以，你想要粗糙的
^3377FF{0} {1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So, you wish to have rough
fire stones? Then I will need
you to bring {0} pure fire stone.
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
所以，你想要粗糙的
火石？那么我需要你带来{0}个纯净火石。
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So, you wish to have rough
water stones? Then I'll need
you to bring {0} pure water stone.
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
所以，你想要粗糙的
水石？那么我需要你带来{0}个纯净水石。
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So, you wish to have rough
wind stones? Then I will need
you to bring {0} pure wind stone.
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
所以，你想要粗糙的
风石？那么我需要你带来{0}个纯净风石。
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
So, you wish to have rough
earth stones? Then I'll need
you to bring {0} pure earth stone.
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
所以，你想要粗糙的
大地能量石？那么我需要你带来{0}个纯净大地能量石。
^3377FF{1} {2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
That's all I need...
Come back when
you're ready.
I will be here.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
这就是全部了...
准备好了再来吧。
我会在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
Hm? You need to enter
a number from 1 to 10.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
嗯？你需要输入
1到10之间的数字。

scripts.text:
[Puchuchartan]
I see. It's your call.
Come back when you need me.
scripts.translation:
[普楚查尔坦]
我明白了。由你决定。
需要我的时候再来吧。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA human skull disturbingly
hangs beside the door. The door is
locked tight, so you can't get in.
As you peer through the keyhole,
you can see somebody moving inside the room.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF一个令人不安的人类头骨
挂在门边。门锁得很紧，
你无法进入。
透过钥匙孔往里看，
可以看到房间里有人在移动。^000000

scripts.text: Examine the skull.
scripts.translation: 检查头骨

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see that the eye sockets
of the skull are empty.
How peculiar...
It seems that Gemstones
would fit perfectly inside of
them.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到头骨的眼眶是空的。
真奇怪...
似乎宝石原石
正好能放进去。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see the left eye socket of the
skull. What do you want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到头骨的左眼眶。
你想做什么？^000000

scripts.text: Leave it as it is.
scripts.translation: 保持原样

scripts.text: Insert a Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入蓝色魔力矿石

scripts.text: Insert a Yellow Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入黄色魔力矿石

scripts.text: Insert a Red Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入红色魔力矿石

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou left the eye socket as it was.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你让眼眶保持原样。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou inserted a {0}
into the eye socket.^000000

^3355FFThe gemstone rolled back out of
the mouth of the skull.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF宝石原石从骷髅的口中
滚了出来。^000000

^3355FF你忘记携带{0}了。
所以无法完成你打算做的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou see the right eye socket of
the skull. What do you want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你看到头骨的右眼眶。
你想做什么？^000000

scripts.text: Leave it as it is.
scripts.translation: 保持原样

scripts.text: Insert a Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入蓝色魔力矿石

scripts.text: Insert a Yellow Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入黄色魔力矿石

scripts.text: Insert a Red Gemstone.
scripts.translation: 放入红色魔力矿石

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou left the eye socket as it was.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你让眼眶保持原样。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou inserted a {0}
into the eye socket.^000000

^3355FFThe gemstone rolled back out of
the mouth of the skull.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF宝石原石从骷髅的口中
滚了出来。^000000

^3355FF你忘记携带{0}了。
所以无法完成你打算做的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing happened.
You have the feeling that the
skull is grinning at you. But...
It's probably just a trick of the light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF什么也没发生。
你感觉头骨正在对你微笑。但是...
那可能只是光影的错觉。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSuddenly, a clicking sound comes
from the skull's eye sockets and
the door opens. Before you know
it, you walk inside as if guided
by an unseen force...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF突然，骷髅的眼眶里传来咔哒咔哒的声响，门开了。不知不觉间，你仿佛被一股无形的力量牵引着走了进去...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided to pass by the door.
It looks like it might be too hard to open.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你决定从门前经过。
这扇门看起来很难打开。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phrenetan]
I am so sick and tired of
my husband!! It's like he
flirts with every girl
in the village!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷内坦]
我受够我那个丈夫了！
他简直跟村里每个女孩都调情！

scripts.text:
[Phrenetan]
If I see him flirting with
women again...I swear...
I will show him hell!!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷内坦]
要是再看到他跟别的女人调情...
我发誓...
我要让他尝尝地狱的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Phrenetan]
Umba~ umbaumbah!
Umbah woomumum!
Umbah woomum umbabah!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷内坦]
Umba~ umbaumbah!
Umbah woomumum!
Umbah woomum umbabah!

scripts.text:
[Phrenetan]
Umbaumbah wooga wooga
Umbaumbabah babababah!
Umbaum!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷内坦]
Umbaumbah wooga wooga
Umbaumbabah babababah!
Umbaum!

scripts.text:
[Phrenetan]
Umbah umbaumba umbah
Umbabababah wooga woo!
Wooga wooga umbabah umbaum!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷内坦]
Umbah umbaumba umbah
Umbabababah wooga woo!
Wooga wooga umbabah umbaum!

scripts.text:
[Phrenetan]
Umbabah! Umbaumbah.....
Umbaum Umbaum Wooga wooga!
Wooga umumum woombababap!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[弗雷内坦]
Umbabah! Umbaumbah.....
Umbaum Umbaum Wooga wooga!
Wooga umumum woombababap!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Hey there, cool cat.
Don't mind the wife...
Much as I love her,
I know my obligations, ya dig?
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
嘿，帅哥。
别介意我老婆...
虽然我很爱她，
但我知道自己的责任，懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
If a man's got plenty, he's
got to share it with those
that got nothing to give.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
如果一个男人拥有很多，
他就必须与那些一无所有的人分享。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
If a man's hands are good
at healin', he's got to use
those hands to help folks live.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
如果一个男人的手擅长治愈，
他就必须用这双手帮助人们活下去。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
If a man's lips be good at
singin', he's got to croon the
songs we like to hear so much.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
如果一个男人的嘴唇擅长歌唱，
他就必须吟唱我们喜爱的歌曲。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
But if sweet lovin' is golden,
then baby...I got the Midas touch.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
但如果甜蜜的爱是金色的，
那么宝贝...我拥有点石成金的本领。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Ooh...!
...........
My back--!
Simmer down, baby, your turn is comin' in a minute~
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
噢...！
...........
我的背--！
冷静点，宝贝，马上轮到你了~

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Man...sometimes my wife can
be a lil' too rough, maybe
even hurtful. But that's cool...
it just means she's got fire.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
天哪...有时候我老婆
可能有点太粗暴，
甚至有点伤人。但这没关系...
这说明她很有激情。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
But someday, she'll have to
learn that I gots to share
this heart of mine with the ladies
who really need a dose of vitamin
lovin', ya dig? It's my obligation.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
但总有一天，她会明白，
我必须把我的心分给那些
真正需要“爱的维生素”的女士们，懂吗？这是我的责任。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Wainatan, Bertztan, Chabimatan...
Those pretty girls been waitin'
toooooo long. Don't worry,
big daddy's comin' soon.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
韦纳坦、贝尔茨坦、查比马坦...
那些漂亮的女孩们
已经等太...太久了。别担心，
大爸爸很快就来了。

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
OOOH~! Phrenetan!
Baby, why you gotta be rough?
Hit me gently, ya dig??
I don't mean to hurt you~
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
噢~！弗雷内坦！
宝贝，你为什么非要这么粗暴？
轻点打我，懂吗？？
我不是故意要伤害你的~

scripts.text:
[Umpokoriohtan]
Umbaumbah...........
Umbahwooga woogawoo!
Umbah umumbabah umbawoo gaga.
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波科里奥坦]
Umbaumbah...........
Umbahwooga woogawoo!
Umbah umumbabah umbawoo gaga.

scripts.text:
[Wainatan]
I am sick and tired of this guy
who always appears at night and bugs the hell out of me...
scripts.translation:
[韦纳坦]
我受够了这个家伙，
他总是在晚上出现，烦死我了...

scripts.text:
